title: The Calm One at the Gate (v2 fix)

style_bible.character: One woman, about 30, olive skin, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, slim build, composed expression.
style_bible.wardrobe: Camel wool coat over a plain white crew tee, black trousers and a matte black carry-on with no logos.
style_bible.setting: A modern glass-walled airport gate with soft-focus seating, then a quiet premium lounge with an aircraft far out on the apron.
style_bible.color_grade: Clean premium grade: cool teal-grey terminal tones, a red accent only in the hook, warm honey tones in the lounge.
style_bible.lens_and_light: 35-50mm shallow depth of field, natural skin texture and soft motivated light, with no mixed-in text or graphics.

scenes.description: Hook, opening in the disruption: a tight close-up of her face lit red by the departure board as the news lands. The board sits behind her as soft bokeh with only red status bars and no legible characters. There is no glass reflection. Blurred travelers slump at the gate seats behind her.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in on a tight close-up, 50mm, very shallow focus.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, camel coat, white tee: close-up, she looks up, brow tightening in worry, face lit red by departure board glow. Behind her, soft-focus gate seats and two blurred travelers slumping; board is only red bokeh bars, no legible characters. Slow push-in, shallow depth of field. Red key light, cool terminal fill, natural skin texture.

scenes.description: Contrast beat: she glances at her phone, which is held low with the screen angled away and glowing softly. She exhales, her shoulders drop and a small smile appears. Stressed travelers pace behind her, out of focus. The background is clean, with no UI elements or floating graphics.
scenes.camera: Static medium close-up with a slight handheld drift, 35mm.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, camel coat, white tee: medium close-up at gate seats, glances at phone held low, screen angled away with soft glow, exhales, shoulders drop, faint smile. Blurred travelers pace and rub temples behind. Clean background, no UI elements, no floating graphics. Static camera, slight drift. Cool terminal light, warm rim light on her face.

scenes.description: She walks away from the chaos toward camera. She pulls her carry-on with one hand and holds a plain white coffee cup in the other, relaxed and unhurried. The gate crowd stays a soft blur behind her.
scenes.camera: Smooth backward tracking shot at waist height, 35mm.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, camel coat, white tee: walks toward camera through bright terminal, pulling black carry-on, plain white paper coffee cup in other hand, relaxed smile. Blurred stressed travelers at gate seats far behind, out of focus. Smooth backward tracking shot, waist height. Daylight through tall windows, soft shadows, natural skin texture.

scenes.description: Resolution in the lounge (location change, same wardrobe and hair). She sits by a floor-to-ceiling window, sips her coffee and lowers the cup with a calm, confident smile. An aircraft is parked at a realistic distance and scale out on the apron. The upper third is clean, soft sky. The editor places the overlay line in that upper third so it never covers her face, hands or cup. Skin should have natural texture and match shot 3.
scenes.camera: Slow push-in at eye level, 50mm, framed low so the upper third stays open.
scenes.video_prompt: Woman, 30, dark wavy shoulder-length hair, camel coat, white tee: now in quiet premium airport lounge, same outfit and hair. Seated low in frame by floor-to-ceiling window, sips coffee, lowers cup, calm confident smile. Aircraft parked at realistic distance and scale on apron, far beyond glass. Upper third clean soft sky. Slow push-in, eye level. Warm interior light, soft daylight, natural skin texture.

sound: Shots 1-2 use real terminal ambience: a muffled boarding chime, a low crowd murmur and one soft collective groan. On her exhale, the noise ducks and a warm, minimal electronic pulse with a soft piano motif fades in. Shots 3-4 settle into the gentle hush of the lounge with a light cup clink, and the music resolves on the end card. No voiceover.
